title: Denoise stack (DeepInterpolation)
description: Removes independent noise with DeepInterpolation (Lecoq et al. 2021), as dev's Denoiser does: in Python with the deepinterpolation package and h5py, in MATLAB with DeepInterpolation-MATLAB and the Deep Learning Toolbox, when installed. Each frame is predicted from the frames around it by a trained network, given as modelPath (an .h5 model, such as the Allen Institute's pretrained two-photon models; in MATLAB also a .mat file with a network as net). Frames too close to the start or end to be predicted are kept as they were.

stack.title: Stack
stack.description: Variable that holds the image stack (height x width x frames).

output.title: Denoised stack
output.description: Variable the result is saved to.

modelPath.title: Model file
modelPath.description: Path of the trained model (.h5; in MATLAB also .mat, the network saved as net)

omittedFrames.title: Frames left out next to the predicted one

firstFrame.title: First frame
firstFrame.description: The first frame to process, from 1 (dev's frame interval): the method works on frames firstFrame..lastFrame only, and its outputs have that many frames.

lastFrame.title: Last frame
lastFrame.description: The last frame to process; 0 for the last frame of the stack.
